name: 举重总成绩/体重系数计算

map.举重总成绩/体重系数计算是做什么的？: What does Weightlifting Total & Sinclair Coefficient Calculator do?
map.如何使用举重总成绩/体重系数计算？: How do I use Weightlifting Total & Sinclair Coefficient Calculator?
map.举重总成绩/体重系数计算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Weightlifting Total & Sinclair Coefficient Calculator best for?
map.计算抓举+挺举总成绩、Sinclair 体重系数与跨体重预测总成绩: Enter snatch and clean-and-jerk results and body weight to compute the total, the Sinclair body-weight coefficient and a cross-bodyweight predicted total for weightlifting scoring and comparison.
map.总成绩 = 抓举+挺举；Sinclair 系数修正: Total = snatch + clean & jerk; Sinclair coefficient adjustment
map.💡 Sinclair 系数 = 10^(A×(log10(b/W))²)，W≤b: 💡 Sinclair coefficient = 10^(A × (log10(b/W))²); for W ≤ b it is a factor greater than 1, used to normalize lifters of different body weights to a comparable standard.
map.⚠️ 系数为 2017–2020 周期参考值，IWF 会定期更新；老将年龄修正为: ⚠️ Coefficients are 2017-2020 cycle reference values and are updated periodically by the IWF; the masters age adjustment is an empirical estimate for reference only.
map.Sinclair 总成绩 = 实际总成绩 × Sinclair 系数，用于跨体重: Sinclair total = actual total × Sinclair coefficient, used for cross-bodyweight comparison
map.体重超过 b（男 175.5kg / 女 153.6kg）时系数为 1.0: When body weight exceeds b (men 175.5 kg / women 153.6 kg) the coefficient is 1.0
map.老将(≥35岁)额外乘年龄修正系数，模拟折算到 35 岁水平: Masters (≥35) are additionally multiplied by an age-adjustment factor, simulating a conversion to the age-35 level
map.跨级别比较用 Sinclair 系数。: Use the Sinclair coefficient for cross-category comparison.
map.不同级别总成绩按 Sinclair 系数归一，跨级别比真实实力。: Normalize totals from different categories by the Sinclair coefficient to compare true strength across categories.
map.抓举 100 kg + 挺举 130 kg = 总成绩 230 kg；再乘该体重: Snatch 100 kg + clean & jerk 130 kg = a 230 kg total; multiply by that bodyweight category's Sinclair coefficient to get a standardized value for cross-category ranking.
map.消除体重优势，使不同级别可横向比。: It removes the body-weight advantage so different categories can be compared side by side.
map.消除轻级别绝对力量劣势，使不同体重级别可比，奥运排名即用此法。: It removes the absolute-strength disadvantage of lighter categories so different body-weight categories are comparable, which is exactly how Olympic ranking is done.
